title: Analysis of Treatment Progression in Atopic Dermatitis During Routine Care: Implementation of 3D Imaging and Automated Score Calculation Considering Environmental and Sociodemographic Factors
summary:
Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a common chronic skin condition that can significantly affect patients’ daily lives. So far, the severity of the disease is usually assessed using questionnaires and clinical scores such as EASI or SCORAD. However, these methods are often subjective and can vary from person to person.
The AD-AutoScore project aims to develop an objective and standardized method to better evaluate the course of the disease. To achieve this, 3D whole-body images and various clinical data are analyzed.
The goal is to identify different types of disease progression and, in the long term, use artificial intelligence to make treatment more personalized and precise.
